about: Hand estimate for Dynamic mode (issue #117): AI.handValue's features with weights fitted to simulated play. value = tricks + 0.9 * kings. Used by the reads of the player and the post-game review, not by the bots. Made by: node handvalue.js 600 4 11 --write.

toCurrentScale.about: fitted value ≈ a + b × AI.handValue, from the same hands. Maps the bid thresholds onto the fitted scale.
